question: In which year was the Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI) formally constituted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI)** was formally constituted in the year **1946**. This marked the establishment of a governing body to oversee athletics in India.
 
• AAFI was formed to promote, regulate, and oversee the development of **track and field sports** across India.
 
• Before 1946, there was no centralized governing body for athletics in India, and the sport was managed in a fragmented manner by regional associations.
 
• The formation of AAFI played a pivotal role in unifying the various regional athletic associations under one national body.
 
• In 2008, the AAFI was renamed as the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)**, which continues to function as the national governing body for athletics in the country.
